questions.prompt: Solve √(2x + 1) = x - 1. Check for extraneous solutions.
questions.prompt_markup: Solve √(2x + 1) = x - 1. Check for extraneous solutions.
questions.grading_note: Form required: the solution, with x = 0 identified as extraneous. Squaring gives x² - 4x = 0, so x = 0 or 4. x = 0 gives √1 = 1 but 0 - 1 = -1, so it fails; x = 4 gives 3 = 3.

questions.prompt: Multiply. Write the answer in the form a + bi. (2 + i)(3 - i)
questions.prompt_markup:
Multiply. Write the answer in the form a + bi.
(2 + i)(3 - i)
questions.grading_note: Form required: a + bi. 6 - 2i + 3i - i² = 6 + i + 1 = 7 + i, because i² = -1.
